what: Retail e-mail test: 64,000 recent customers sent a men's or women's e-mail, or none, at random
licence: published by Kevin Hillstrom (MineThatData) for analysis; no licence stated

rankings.response: predicted outcome if treated: finds people likely to act anyway
rankings.s_learner: one model with the treatment as an input

measures.top30_share_of_total_lift: share of the campaign's total incremental outcome in the top 30% of the ranking
measures.uplift_top30_per_customer: treated minus untreated outcome per customer within the top 30%
measures.top30_against_average: that, divided by the same difference over everyone
measures.qini_ours: area between the Qini curve and the random line, divided by the campaign's total gain (this project's own normalisation)
measures.qini_auc_score: scikit-uplift's qini_auc_score: the same area divided by a perfect ranking's (0/1 outcomes only)
